description: Implementation of a basic HTTP server that serves files from assets. Handles a single request at a time and supports only GET requests.

classes.name: SimpleWebServer
classes.description: A simple HTTP server class that manages server socket, handles client requests, and serves static files from assets.

methods.name: SimpleWebServer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the server with a designated port and asset manager.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the server in a new thread and begins listening for incoming connections.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the server and closes the server socket.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port number on which the server is listening.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main server loop that accepts incoming connections and delegates handling.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes an individual client request, reads HTTP headers, retrieves content, and sends HTTP response.

methods.name: loadContent
methods.description: Loads content of requested file from assets into a byte array.

methods.name: detectMimeType
methods.description: Determines MIME type based on the filename extension.
